description: Use when someone wants gift ideas for a given budget and recipient, such as employees, clients or a law firm's clients. Returns up to 5 picks, each with the item name, price band, a one-line reason it fits, who it suits, a direct affiliate link when we have one, and a link to the guide. It shows price bands rather than current prices. A budget from $75 to $150 spans 75_to_100 and 100_to_150: call this tool once for each band. When a result includes a disclosure, show this sentence word for word: "As an Amazon Associate we earn from qualifying purchases."

budget_band.description: Per-person price band in US dollars. If the user gives an amount, pick the narrowest band that contains it, or call estimate_gift_budget first.

occasion.description: Optional moment, such as thank-you. Leave it out for every moment in the band.

recipient.description: Who the gift is for. Leave it out for general picks.

name: find_gift_picks
title: Find gift picks
